name: Capgo

Founded Nov 2021, EE. Team 2–5, bootstrapped. Founder Martin Donadieu. ~7,800 estimated users (founder-stated). SOC 2 Type II / SOC 3 / ISO 27001 (founder-stated). Stack: Astro, Vue, Supabase, Cloudflare, Resend, Stripe. DR 59.

mentions.indieAngle: If Capacitor is crowded, do the same OTA + channel + rollback story for Expo/React Native shops that refuse full Expo EAS, or sell a "hotfix channel" managed service for agencies that ship 10+ client apps and hate store review roulette.

whyItPrints: App Store review delay is a permanent tax on mobile teams. Capgo sells the missing "CodePush for Capacitor" wedge — devops glue, not a consumer AI app. ~1,167 subs at ~$32k MRR with ~47% L30 margin and ~38k L30 visitors is a real B2B tools business. MRR growing +6.8% even while L30 cash is −10.7%.
whyThisMatters:
You ship a JavaScript or CSS fix to a Capacitor app without waiting on the App Store. It goes on a channel, you can roll it out in stages, and you can roll it back. They also build the signed iOS and Android files in the cloud, so you don't need a Mac on the desk.

You publish from the terminal or from your build pipeline. There's native push, release logs, and more than one hundred fifty open-source plugins. They also offer a way off Ionic's enterprise plugins.

Martin Donadieu started it in Estonia in November 2021. Two to five people, still bootstrapped. He says they hold SOC 2 Type II, SOC 3, and ISO 27001.
